readings.meaning: agenda, menu, or table of contents

ambiguity: Easily confused with the framed bulleted list with a plus sign if the task involves a list of any kind, and at small sizes the three stacked dots on the left look very similar to the exclamation mark in the alert card.
task_intents: write a packing or shopping list
compile a guest list or roster
draft an outline or table of contents

reasoning: Shows three bullet points and lines inside a rounded square frame, universally read as a bulleted list, checklist, or agenda. In a to-do app it is somewhat meta, but still useful for tasks whose explicit output is a list, roster, inventory, or meeting agenda; it strongly overlaps with unframed list and checklist icons.

pass1.ambiguity: Almost identical to an unbordered bulleted list icon or a checklist icon, and can be seen as generic UI chrome for 'list view'.

distinguishing: Shows an unmodified rounded square frame with three circular bullet points and three text bars, lacking both the bottom-right plus badge of the add-list icon and the left-hand exclamation mark of the alert card.
